confidence_notes: The RBA rate is from a search result showing the 18 Nov 2026 observation. Food and drink anchors rest on the second search, which only returned July 2025 Expat Arrivals figures in ARS (cappuccino 6,100; draft beer 6,000; mid-range meal for two 105,000) plus a Feb 2025 Buenos Aires Herald piece. I did not find current 2026 prices. I adjusted those figures for inflation and for the peso/USD rate, so the USD values are rough. The inexpensive meal and cocktail figures are my judgement, since no current direct data was found. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked. Argentine prices and the exchange rate are volatile, so uncertainty is high.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Buenos Aires peso price data from 2025, adjusted upward for inflation and the peso rate. Roughly comparable to other mid-priced South American capitals such as Santiago, though restaurant prices are somewhat lower.
